title: Blackberry Blueberry Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blackberry Blueberry Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Dive into a flavor explosion with the Blackberry Blueberry Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. This expertly crafted disposable vape blends the rich tartness of blackberries with the sweet juiciness of blueberries, delivering a smooth, satisfying taste you won’t want to put down.
Convenience Meets Flavor Perfection
The Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is designed for effortless vaping. With its sleek, disposable design, there’s no need to refill or charge. Just unwrap, vape, and enjoy pure, uninterrupted flavor. Perfect for your busy lifestyle, it fits right in your pocket for on-the-go convenience.
Vivid Taste, Every Single Draw
Every puff is a burst of berry goodness, capturing the essence of freshly picked fruit. Thanks to advanced vaping technology, the flavors remain consistent from the first hit to the very last.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Why Settle for Ordinary?
Elevate your vaping experience with the Blackberry Blueberry Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or just dabbling, this flavor-forward option ensures satisfaction like no other. Try it today and savor the simplicity of vaping reimagined.
